create_sawyer_sweep_env: create a SawyerSweepEnv instance to simulate a Sawyer robot sweeping task in MuJoCo
run_sawyer_sweep_step: run a step on the SawyerSweepEnv with an action to get observation, reward, and info
reset_sawyer_sweep_model: reset the SawyerSweepEnv model to initial state with optional random object and goal positions
compute_sawyer_sweep_reward: compute the reward for a sweep action based on reach distance and push distance metrics
review_sawyer_sweep_reward_function: review the compute_reward method to understand reach and push reward shaping in the sweep task
